Section 九 / exp40 crash diagnosis: FiLM-GCM + brightness_HSV + blur is the exact GCM-induced-NaN combination (gaussian_blur smooths extreme HSV values -> GCM learns extreme scale/shift). This challenge is gamma_HSV:5 + gaussian blur -> GCM excluded on stability grounds in addition to the failed contrast gate.

Section 五 组件验证: SimpleGate (exp39) -32K params, safe on 8/9 degradations (B +0.06, gamma-x3 SF5 -0.14 ~= neutral) -> default-on; CSN catastrophic on pure-global (-4.6~-11.7 dB); DualBranch blind-ID 0/24 (exp37); SCA 8/9 harmful (removed); GDFN +0.22 marginal; FPro torch.fft x compile incompatible; PCP parameter-unfair (+91K per-block, shared unverified); ChannelCurve stretch-specific, ineffective for gamma.
finetune_strategy_ref: Section 六 Step 0 (degradation difficulty): low-mid difficulty (gamma darken + gaussian blur sev1) -> pure Swin + SimpleGate default-on.

Section 六 Step 1 (training strategy): pipeline contains a global brightness step (gamma darken) -> Direct (conservative); True Ft (AR_LOAD_CKPT) not recommended (1.5h/2-epoch budget ~ Direct, exp37); task mandates Direct from scratch.

Section 六 Step 2 (per-step component gating): both steps LIKELY, but no step matches a component-trigger signal — no contrast step, no motion (Tier A OCAB gate), no brightness_HSV NaN risk once GCM is off -> only SimpleGate fires.
Section 七 信号可靠性分层: Tier A/0%-FP gates (anisotropy_ratio > 1.7, valid variance_ratio contrast) not satisfied; Tier B/C -> Swin baseline; SimpleGate 可常开.
Section 七 全组件启用条件 / 信号->组件映射流程: only the default branch fires — Swin + SimpleGate + Direct.
Section 五 注意力类型选择 + 参数公平性: brightness+blur -> Swin baseline; gamma components ~0 dB (组件无效); OCAB only for motion sev>=5/anisotropy.
reasoning: The predicted pipeline blur_gaussian:1 -> brightness_darken_gamma_HSV:5 is pixel-perfect (0 differing pixels on 5/5 support pairs, PSNR=inf, CI 10/10, Tier 1 LIKELY), so identification confidence is very high and no conservative architecture is needed to absorb mis-identification. Strategy: Direct from scratch per Section 六 Step 1 and the Section 二 gamma row (global brightness -> Direct; True Ft gives ~0 dB at this budget, exp37). Attention: swin at window 8 — the motion trigger for OCAB (anisotropy_ratio > 1.7, 0% FP) is absent (FFT anisotropy 0.00, PCA 0.0), and Section 五 maps brightness+blur to the Swin baseline; ws=16 is reserved for motion sev>=5. Components: variance_ratio != 1.0 is clipping-induced by the V-gamma (contrast_from_variance=false, spread_ratio 0.74-1.08, zero residual without a contrast step), so the Tier A contrast gate does not fire and neither ColorPre nor FiLM-GCM is enabled; FiLM-GCM is additionally excluded because gamma_HSV + gaussian blur is precisely the Section 九/exp40 GCM-induced-NaN combination. CSN is banned on pure-global degradation; DualBranch is not recommended in blind-ID (exp37 0/24); SCA/GDFN/FPro/PCP/ChannelCurve are deprecated, marginal, unstable, parameter-unfair, or stretch-specific. ColorMLP is a Tier B brightness_HSV aid whose NaN-mitigation purpose exists only with GCM; with GCM off and gamma being low difficulty (Section 五: gamma components ~0 dB), it stays off. SimpleGate remains on per the Section 七 default-on rule (8/9 safe, -32K). Final: Direct + pure Swin(ws=8) + SimpleGate, lr=5e-4, 2 epochs, batch 16, predicted pipeline unchanged. Caveat: exp39 saw one epoch-2 last-checkpoint collapse with SimpleGate (D3); if the last checkpoint degrades, use the best-checkpoint epoch.
